name: NSK Ltd.
summary: NSK Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial machinery bearings, automotive products, and precision equipment and parts worldwide. The company's products include ball bearings; roller bearings; bearing units; super precision bearings; bearings for steel industry, mining and construction, papermaking machines, and pumps and compressors; and bearings for special environments, including sanitary, corrosion-resistant, vacuum, cleanroom, high-temperature, non-magnetic requirement, and dust-contaminated environments.
